embeds.title: 🔴 Hackers Exploit Auth Bypass Flaw in Burst Statistics WordPress Plugin
embeds.description:
Hackers are leveraging CVE-2026-8181, a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in the Burst Statistics WordPress plugin, to obtain admin-level access to websites. According to Wordfence, the flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to impersonate known admin users during REST API requests and create rogue admin accounts. The vulnerability was introduced in version 3.4.0 on April 23 and persisted in version 3.4.1. Wordfence reports blocking over 7,400 attacks targeting this vulnerability in the past 24 hours. The plugin is active on approximately 200,000 WordPress sites, with roughly 115,000 sites remaining exposed after the May 12 patch release (version 3.4.2).
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-8181 • **Access:** Authentication bypass via REST API requests
**Incident date:** 2026-04-23 • **Confidence:** claim
[Read source](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hackers-exploit-auth-bypass-flaw-in-burst-statistics-wordpress-plugin/)
